layout_sources: https://github.com/bank2ynab/bank2ynab/blob/develop/bank2ynab/data/bank2ynab.conf [SE SEB Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken] (file "kontoutdrag", semicolon, one header row, 6 columns Date,skip,skip,Payee,Inflow,skip, %Y-%m-%d)

https://github.com/gerasiov/ofxstatement-seb/blob/HEAD/ofxstatement/plugins/seb.py (the same six headings, exactly: Bokföringsdatum, Valutadatum, Verifikationsnummer, Text/mottagare, Belopp, Saldo; card lines end "/YY-MM-DD" with the purchase day; that plugin reads the Excel export Export.xlsx)
notes: SEB internet bank "kontoutdrag" CSV. Semicolon-separated, unquoted, one header row, dates YYYY-MM-DD, Belopp signed, Saldo after each line, newest first. Not confirmed: the decimal form (a comma decimal with no thousands mark is assumed; some reports mention a point), the encoding (Windows-1252 assumed for Bokföringsdatum/LÖN) and CRLF. SEB also offers an Excel download (Export.xlsx) with the same columns under a summary block. The currency is not named in the file (SEK). Closing = the newest line's Saldo; opening = the oldest line's Saldo minus its amount.
